answer: Give every established identity a unique, unforgeable pigment - a cryptographic mark earned only by completing costly, verifiable work over time. A sable ledger records each mark history, so a fresh fake identity starts with no reputation and cannot borrow another own. Honest agents cluster around an oasis of trusted peers, sharing attestations only with identities whose pigment traces back to real work. Forging a thousand convincing marks costs a thousand times the work, so Sybil attacks stop scaling.
